title: Siyosat va xalqaro munosabatlar lug‘ati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siyosiy va xalqaro munosabatlar atamalarini aniq ishlatasiz, diplomatik iboralar va gazeta sarlavhalarini to‘g‘ri tushunasiz, bahsli voqeani betaraf fe’llar va manbaga bog‘lash orqali xolis tasvirlaysiz va xalqaro yangilikni fon, tomonlar, oqibat va noaniqlik bo‘yicha tahlil qilasiz.

scenes.title: Siyosat tili
board: Politics and International Relations
(Siyosat va xalqaro munosabatlar lug‘ati)
terms · diplomatic language · neutrality · news analysis
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda falsafa va axloq mavzularida hurmat bilan bahslashishni o‘rgandik. Bugun yangiliklar va diplomatiya tiliga o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida siyosiy atamalarni aniq ishlatasiz, diplomatik va gazeta tilini tushunasiz, voqeani xolis tasvirlaysiz va xalqaro yangilikni betaraf tahlil qilasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we debated questions of ethics. Today we turn to the language of politics, diplomacy and the news, and above all to describing contested events neutrally.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi safar axloqiy masalalar bo‘yicha bahslashdik. Bugun siyosat, diplomatiya va yangiliklar tiliga, eng avvalo, bahsli voqealarni xolis tasvirlashga o‘tamiz.

scenes.title: Hokimiyat tarmoqlari
board: legislature (qonun chiqaruvchi) · executive (ijro) · judiciary (sud)
bicameral parliament: two chambers
UK: Commons + Lords · US Congress: House + Senate
coalition · opposition · cabinet
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: siyosiy atamalar. Hokimiyat uch tarmoqqa bo‘linadi: legislature qonun chiqaradi, executive ijro etadi, judiciary sud hokimiyati. Ko‘p davlatlarda parlament bicameral, ya’ni ikki palatali: Britaniyada House of Commons va House of Lords, AQShda Congress tarkibida House of Representatives va Senate. O‘zbekistonda ham Oliy Majlis ikki palatali: Qonunchilik palatasi va Senat.
scenes.say: Power is typically divided between the legislature, the executive and the judiciary. A bicameral parliament has two chambers. When no party wins outright, parties may form a coalition, while the largest party outside government leads the opposition.
scenes.say_uz: Hokimiyat odatda qonun chiqaruvchi, ijro va sud tarmoqlariga bo‘linadi. Ikki palatali parlamentda ikkita palata bor. Hech bir partiya to‘liq g‘alaba qozonmasa, partiyalar koalitsiya tuzishi mumkin, hukumatdan tashqaridagi eng katta partiya esa muxolifatni boshqaradi.

scenes.title: Saylov lug‘ati
board: turnout (saylovchilar faolligi) · constituency (saylov okrugi)
incumbent (amaldagi rahbar) · landslide (katta g‘alaba)
hung parliament (UK) · by-election (UK) = special election (US)

examples.t: Turnout fell to its lowest level in decades.
examples.uz: Saylovchilar faolligi so‘nggi o‘n yilliklardagi eng past darajaga tushdi.

scenes.say_native: Saylov lug‘ati. Turnout saylovchilar faolligi, constituency saylov okrugi. Incumbent hozir lavozimda turgan rahbar. Landslide juda katta farqli g‘alaba. Hung parliament Britaniyada hech bir partiya ko‘pchilikni olmagan parlament. By-election oraliq saylov, Amerikada uni ko‘pincha special election deyishadi.
scenes.say: The incumbent won by a landslide, though turnout was low. In Britain, a hung parliament means no single party holds a majority, and a by-election fills a single vacant seat between general elections.
scenes.say_uz: Amaldagi rahbar katta farq bilan g‘olib chiqdi, ammo faollik past edi. Britaniyada hung parliament hech bir partiya ko‘pchilikka ega emasligini bildiradi, by-election esa umumiy saylovlar oralig‘ida bitta bo‘sh o‘rinni to‘ldiradi.

scenes.title: Qonun qabul qilish
board: bill → act / law · amendment · referendum
to pass · to veto · to ratify a treaty
UK: table a motion = propose it
US: table a motion = postpone it
scenes.say_native: Qonun loyihasi bill deyiladi, qabul qilingach act yoki law bo‘ladi. Amendment o‘zgartirish, referendum umumxalq ovozi. Parlament loyihani pass qiladi, prezident uni veto qilishi mumkin, xalqaro shartnoma esa ratify, ya’ni ratifikatsiya qilinadi. Diqqat: “table a motion” Britaniyada “taklifni muhokamaga qo‘ymoq”, Amerikada esa aksincha, “muhokamani kechiktirmoq”.
scenes.say: A bill becomes an act once it is passed. Leaders may veto legislation, and treaties must be ratified. Beware of table: in Britain, to table a motion is to propose it; in America, it means to set it aside.
scenes.say_uz: Qonun loyihasi qabul qilingach qonunga aylanadi. Rahbarlar qonunga veto qo‘yishi mumkin, shartnomalar esa ratifikatsiya qilinishi kerak. Table so‘zidan ehtiyot bo‘ling: Britaniyada taklifni kiritish, Amerikada esa uni chetga surish degani.

scenes.title: Xalqaro munosabatlar atamalari
board: sovereignty (suverenitet) · territorial integrity
bilateral / multilateral talks
sanctions · treaty · summit · ceasefire
envoy · embassy · consulate

examples.t: The two sides agreed to a ceasefire at the summit.
examples.uz: Ikki tomon sammitda o‘t ochishni to‘xtatishga kelishdi.

scenes.say_native: Xalqaro munosabatlar. Sovereignty suverenitet, territorial integrity hududiy yaxlitlik. Bilateral talks ikki tomonlama, multilateral esa ko‘p tomonlama muzokaralar. Sanctions jazo choralari, treaty shartnoma, summit oliy darajadagi uchrashuv, ceasefire o‘t ochishni to‘xtatish. Envoy maxsus vakil, embassy elchixona, consulate konsullik.
scenes.say: Sovereign states conduct bilateral and multilateral talks, sign treaties, impose sanctions and, in conflict, negotiate ceasefires. An envoy is a special representative, usually sent for a particular mission.
scenes.say_uz: Suveren davlatlar ikki va ko‘p tomonlama muzokaralar olib boradi, shartnomalar imzolaydi, sanksiyalar joriy qiladi va mojaroda o‘t ochishni to‘xtatish haqida kelishadi. Envoy odatda muayyan vazifa uchun yuborilgan maxsus vakil.

scenes.title: Siyosat: bir so‘z, uch ma’no
board: politics: the activity / field (siyosat)
policy: a plan of action (siyosat, yo‘l)
political (adj.) · politician (person)
politic (rare): wise, prudent

examples.t: The government's housing policy is controversial.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tillarida bitta “siyosat”, “политика” so‘zi ikki ingliz so‘ziga mos keladi. Politics bu faoliyat yoki soha: hokimiyat uchun kurash, partiyalar, saylovlar. Policy esa aniq reja yoki yo‘l: “housing policy”, “foreign policy”. Demak, “tashqi siyosat” foreign policy, foreign politics emas. Politic esa kamdan-kam ishlatiladigan, “oqilona” ma’nosidagi sifat.
scenes.say: Politics is the arena; a policy is a specific course of action. So we speak of foreign policy and education policy, but of party politics and a career in politics. Note that politics usually takes a singular verb.
scenes.say_uz: Politics bu maydon, policy esa aniq harakat yo‘li. Shuning uchun foreign policy va education policy deymiz, lekin party politics va siyosatdagi martaba deymiz. Politics odatda birlikdagi fe’l bilan keladi.

scenes.title: Atamalardagi xatolar
board: ✗ Uzbekistan's foreign politics is open.
✓ Uzbekistan's foreign policy is open.
✗ He is a famous politic.
✓ He is a well-known politician.
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. Birinchisi: “foreign politics”. To‘g‘risi “foreign policy”. Ikkinchisi: “politic” ni shaxs ma’nosida ishlatish. Shaxs politician, sifat esa political. Uchinchisi: “economic” va “economical” ni chalkashtirish. Economic iqtisodiyotga oid: “economic sanctions”. Economical esa tejamkor: “an economical car”. Shuning uchun “economical sanctions” deyilmaydi.
scenes.say: Say foreign policy, not foreign politics; a politician, not a politic. And distinguish economic, relating to the economy, from economical, meaning thrifty: economic sanctions, an economical engine.
scenes.say_uz: Foreign politics emas, foreign policy deng; politic emas, politician. Economic, ya’ni iqtisodiyotga oid, va economical, ya’ni tejamkor so‘zlarini farqlang: economic sanctions, an economical engine.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang
board: 1 The government announced a new climate ___. (politics / policy)
2 The EU imposed ___ sanctions. (economic / economical)
3 The president may ___ the bill.
4 Fewer people voted: ___ was low.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi va ikkinchisida to‘g‘ri variantni tanlang. Uchinchisida prezident qonun loyihasini rad etishi uchun kerakli fe’lni, to‘rtinchisida esa saylovchilar faolligini bildiruvchi otni ayting. Pauza oling va javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: the government announced a new climate politics, or policy. Two: the EU imposed economic, or economical, sanctions. Three: the president may do what to the bill? Four: fewer people voted, so what was low?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: hukumat yangi iqlim siyosatini e’lon qildi, politics yoki policy. Ikki: Yevropa Ittifoqi economic yoki economical sanksiyalar joriy qildi. Uch: prezident qonun loyihasini nima qilishi mumkin? To‘rt: kamroq odam ovoz berdi, nima past edi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 policy
2 economic
3 veto
4 turnout
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: policy, chunki bu aniq reja. Ikkinchi: economic, chunki sanksiyalar iqtisodiyotga oid, tejamkor emas. Uchinchi: veto, prezident loyihaga veto qo‘yishi mumkin. To‘rtinchi: turnout, ya’ni saylovchilar faolligi past edi. Bu to‘rt so‘z yangiliklarda deyarli har kuni uchraydi, ularni avtomatik ishlatishga odatlaning.
scenes.say: Policy, because it is a plan of action. Economic, since the sanctions relate to the economy. Veto. And turnout was low.
scenes.say_uz: Policy, chunki bu harakat rejasi. Economic, chunki sanksiyalar iqtisodiyotga oid. Veto. Va faollik past edi.

scenes.title: Diplomatik til
board: frank and candid talks → serious disagreement
constructive talks → some progress, no deal
a useful exchange of views → little agreement
we take note of → we do not accept
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: diplomatik va jurnalistik til. Diplomatlar ochiq gapirmaydi, ularning iboralarini “tarjima” qilish kerak. “Frank and candid talks” odatda jiddiy kelishmovchilik bo‘lganini bildiradi. “Constructive talks” biroz siljish bor, lekin kelishuv yo‘q. “A useful exchange of views” deyarli hech narsada kelishilmadi degani. “We take note of” esa “qabul qilmaymiz” ma’nosiga yaqin.
scenes.say: Diplomatic language is coded. Frank and candid talks usually signal sharp disagreement; constructive suggests modest progress; and a useful exchange of views often means very little was agreed.
scenes.say_uz: Diplomatik til shifrlangan. Frank and candid talks odatda keskin kelishmovchilikni bildiradi, constructive kichik siljishni anglatadi, a useful exchange of views esa ko‘pincha deyarli hech narsada kelishilmaganini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Munosabat darajalari
board: notes with concern → expresses deep concern
→ condemns → strongly condemns
summons the ambassador → recalls its ambassador
→ expels diplomats → severs diplomatic ties
scenes.say_native: Diplomatik bayonotlar zinapoyaga o‘xshaydi. Eng yumshog‘i: “notes with concern”. Keyin “expresses deep concern”, so‘ng “condemns” va “strongly condemns”. Amaliy qadamlar ham bosqichma-bosqich: elchini tushuntirish uchun chaqirish, ya’ni summon, o‘z elchisini qaytarib olish, ya’ni recall, diplomatlarni chiqarib yuborish, ya’ni expel, va eng og‘iri, diplomatik aloqalarni uzish.
scenes.say: Diplomatic responses escalate step by step: from noting with concern, to condemning, to summoning or recalling an ambassador, expelling diplomats and, ultimately, severing diplomatic ties.
scenes.say_uz: Diplomatik javoblar bosqichma-bosqich kuchayadi: xavotir bilan qayd etishdan qoralashgacha, elchini chaqirish yoki qaytarib olishdan diplomatlarni chiqarib yuborish va, nihoyat, diplomatik aloqalarni uzishgacha.

scenes.title: Sarlavha tili
board: Present simple = past event: PM resigns
to + infinitive = future: Minister to visit Tashkent
No articles, no 'be': Talks stalled
Short words: bid, row, slam, vow, curb, probe, axe, back
scenes.say_native: Gazeta sarlavhalarining o‘z grammatikasi bor. Hozirgi oddiy zamon o‘tgan voqeani bildiradi: “PM resigns”, ya’ni bosh vazir iste’foga chiqdi. Infinitiv kelajakni: “Minister to visit Tashkent”. Artikllar va “be” fe’li tushib qoladi. Qisqa so‘zlar: bid urinish, row janjal, slam keskin tanqid qilmoq, vow va’da bermoq, curb cheklamoq, probe tergov, axe bekor qilmoq, back qo‘llab-quvvatlamoq.
scenes.say: Headlines have their own grammar. The present simple reports past events, an infinitive signals the future, and articles disappear. Short, punchy words replace longer ones: a row is a dispute, a probe is an investigation.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhalarning o‘z grammatikasi bor. Hozirgi oddiy zamon o‘tgan voqeani xabar qiladi, infinitiv kelajakni bildiradi, artikllar esa tushib qoladi. Qisqa, keskin so‘zlar uzunlarining o‘rnini oladi: row janjal, probe tergov.

scenes.title: Sarlavhalarni tinglang
board: Listen to five headlines
Decode each into a full sentence
scenes.say_native: Beshta sarlavhani tinglang. Har birini xayolan to‘liq gapga aylantiring: kim, nima qildi yoki qiladi? Zamonga e’tibor bering, chunki “resigns” o‘tgan, “to visit” esa kelajakni bildiradi. Keyingi qismda birga tahlil qilamiz. Har bir sarlavhadagi qisqa so‘zning rasmiy muqobilini ham eslang.
scenes.say: One: Minister quits over expenses row. Two: PM vows to curb inflation. Three: Opposition slams budget. Four: President to attend climate summit. Five: Probe launched into election funding.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Vazir xarajatlar janjali tufayli iste’foga chiqdi. Ikki: Bosh vazir inflyatsiyani jilovlashga va’da berdi. Uch: Muxolifat byudjetni keskin tanqid qildi. To‘rt: Prezident iqlim sammitida qatnashadi. Besh: Saylov moliyasi yuzasidan tergov boshlandi.

scenes.title: Sarlavhalar tahlili
board: 1 A minister has resigned because of a dispute over expenses.
2 The PM has promised to limit inflation.
3 The opposition has strongly criticised the budget.
4 The president will attend... · 5 An investigation has been launched...
scenes.say_native: Tahlil. Birinchi: “quits” hozirgi zamonda, lekin ma’nosi “has resigned”, “row” esa janjal. Ikkinchi: “vows to curb” va’da berdi, jilovlashga. Uchinchi: “slams” keskin tanqid qildi, rasmiy matnda “strongly criticised”. To‘rtinchi: “to attend” kelajak. Beshinchi: “Probe launched” da “has been” tushib qolgan, ya’ni majhul nisbat. Bu so‘zlarni o‘qishda tushuning, lekin rasmiy yozuvda ishlatmang.
scenes.say: Each headline compresses a full sentence. Quits means has resigned, vows means has promised, slams means has strongly criticised, and probe launched is a passive with has been omitted.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir sarlavha to‘liq gapni siqadi. Quits has resigned, vows has promised, slams has strongly criticised degani, probe launched esa has been tushib qolgan majhul nisbat.

scenes.title: Sarlavha so‘zlarini noto‘g‘ri ishlatish
board: ✗ (in an essay) The opposition slammed the budget.
✓ The opposition strongly criticised the budget.
✗ Reading 'PM resigns' as a habit
✓ It reports a single, recent event.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: sarlavha so‘zlarini rasmiy matnga ko‘chirish. “Slam”, “row”, “axe” gazeta uchun yaxshi, lekin esse yoki hisobotda “strongly criticise”, “dispute”, “abolish” ishlating. Ikkinchisi: sarlavhadagi hozirgi zamonni odat deb tushunish. “PM resigns” bosh vazir doim iste’foga chiqadi degani emas, bu yaqinda bo‘lgan bitta voqea.
scenes.say: Headline vocabulary is vivid but informal. In an essay or report, prefer strongly criticise to slam and dispute to row. And remember that a headline in the present simple reports a single recent event, not a habit.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavha lug‘ati jonli, ammo norasmiy. Esse yoki hisobotda slam o‘rniga strongly criticise, row o‘rniga dispute ishlating. Hozirgi oddiy zamondagi sarlavha odatni emas, yaqindagi bitta voqeani xabar qiladi.

scenes.title: Sarlavha va diplomatiya
board: 1 Decode: 'Govt to axe tax on fuel'
2 Decode: 'Senator backs peace bid'
3 What does 'frank and candid talks' suggest?
4 Stronger: 'expresses concern' or 'condemns'?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi va ikkinchisida sarlavhani to‘liq rasmiy gapga aylantiring, zamonga e’tibor bering. Uchinchisida diplomatik iboraning yashirin ma’nosini ayting. To‘rtinchisida qaysi bayonot kuchliroq ekanini tanlang. Pauza. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: decode govt to axe tax on fuel. Two: decode senator backs peace bid. Three: what does frank and candid talks suggest? Four: which is stronger, expresses concern or condemns?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: govt to axe tax on fuel sarlavhasini oching. Ikki: senator backs peace bid sarlavhasini oching. Uch: frank and candid talks nimani anglatadi? To‘rt: qaysi biri kuchliroq, expresses concern yoki condemns?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 The government will abolish the tax on fuel.
2 A senator has supported an attempt to achieve peace.
3 serious disagreement
4 condemns
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The government will abolish the tax on fuel”, chunki “to axe” kelajak va bekor qilish ma’nosida. Ikkinchi: “A senator has supported an attempt to achieve peace”, “bid” urinish, “back” qo‘llab-quvvatlash. Uchinchi: jiddiy kelishmovchilik. To‘rtinchi: “condemns”, u “expresses concern” dan ancha kuchli.
scenes.say: The government will abolish the fuel tax. A senator has supported an attempt to secure peace. Frank and candid talks suggest serious disagreement. And condemns is considerably stronger than expresses concern.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat yoqilg‘i solig‘ini bekor qiladi. Senator tinchlikka erishish urinishini qo‘llab-quvvatladi. Frank and candid talks jiddiy kelishmovchilikni anglatadi. Condemns esa expresses concern dan ancha kuchli.

scenes.title: Bo‘yoqdor va betaraf so‘zlar
board: regime → government · administration
terrorists / freedom fighters → armed group, militants
crackdown → security operation (+ attribution)
Loaded words take sides; neutral words describe.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: betaraf tasvir. Ko‘p siyosiy so‘zlar bo‘yoqdor, ya’ni tomon oladi. “Regime” salbiy, “government” yoki “administration” betaraf. Bir guruhni bir tomon “terrorists”, boshqasi “freedom fighters” deydi, xolis manba esa “armed group” yoki “militants” deydi. Xalqaro agentliklar bunday so‘zlarni ko‘pincha faqat iqtibos ichida, aniq kimga tegishli ekanini aytib ishlatadi.
scenes.say: Many political words carry a verdict. Regime implies illegitimacy; government does not. Neutral reporting chooses descriptive terms, or attributes loaded ones to a named source inside quotation marks.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p siyosiy so‘zlar hukm tashiydi. Regime noqonuniylikni nazarda tutadi, government esa yo‘q. Xolis xabar tasviriy atamalarni tanlaydi yoki bo‘yoqdor so‘zlarni iqtibos ichida aniq manbaga bog‘laydi.

scenes.title: Xolis keltirish fe’llari
board: neutral: say · state · according to · announce
evaluative: claim (doubt) · admit (guilt) · insist
concede · allege · deny

examples.t: The ministry said the figures were accurate.
The ministry admitted the figures were wrong.
examples.uz: Vazirlik raqamlar xato ekanini tan oldi.

scenes.say_native: Keltirish fe’llari ham betaraf yoki baholovchi bo‘ladi. “Say”, “state”, “according to” eng xolis. “Claim” o‘quvchida shubha uyg‘otadi, “admit” aybni tan olishni bildiradi, “insist” esa qarshilikka qaramay turib olishni. Agar “the minister admitted” desangiz, siz allaqachon vazir xato qilgan deb hukm chiqargan bo‘lasiz. Shuning uchun xolis xabarda “said” eng xavfsiz tanlov.
scenes.say: Reporting verbs are never quite innocent. Said is neutral; claimed casts doubt; admitted implies wrongdoing; insisted suggests resistance. Choose deliberately, because the verb can carry your judgement.
scenes.say_uz: Keltirish fe’llari hech qachon to‘liq beozor emas. Said betaraf, claimed shubha tug‘diradi, admitted aybni nazarda tutadi, insisted qarshilikni bildiradi. Ongli tanlang, chunki fe’l sizning hukmingizni tashishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Manbaga bog‘lash va ehtiyotkorlik
board: X is reported / believed / said to have...
It is understood that... · reportedly · allegedly
Officials, speaking on condition of anonymity, ...

examples.t: The general is believed to have fled the capital.

scenes.say_native: Tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumot uchun maxsus tuzilmalar bor. Majhul nisbatli keltirish: “The general is believed to have fled”, “He is said to have resigned”. Ravishlar: “reportedly”, ya’ni xabarlarga ko‘ra, “allegedly”, ya’ni da’vo qilinishicha. “Allegedly” ayniqsa jinoyat ayblovlarida muhim: sud qaror chiqarmaguncha shaxs aybdor deb yozilmaydi.
scenes.say: Unconfirmed information needs signalling. Use passive reporting structures such as is believed to have, or adverbs such as reportedly and allegedly. Until a court rules, a suspect allegedly committed the crime.
scenes.say_uz: Tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumotga ishora kerak. Is believed to have kabi majhul keltirish tuzilmalari yoki reportedly, allegedly kabi ravishlarni ishlating. Sud qaror chiqarmaguncha gumondor jinoyatni allegedly sodir etgan bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Muvozanat: ikkala tomon
board: Supporters argue that... while critics contend that...
The government maintains... ; opponents counter that...
Equal space · comparable verbs · named sources
scenes.say_native: Xolislikning yana bir sharti muvozanat. Ikkala tomonga ham joy bering va ularga bir xil kuchdagi fe’llarni ishlating. Agar bir tomon “argues”, ikkinchisi “claims” desangiz, muvozanat buziladi. Foydali qolip: “Supporters argue that…, while critics contend that…”. Har bir fikrni aniq manbaga bog‘lang: “the finance minister”, “opposition leaders”, “independent economists”.
scenes.say: Balance means giving each side comparable space and comparable verbs. If one side argues and the other merely claims, you have already chosen a winner. Supporters argue, while critics contend: that is balance.
scenes.say_uz: Muvozanat har bir tomonga taqqoslanadigan joy va fe’l berishni bildiradi. Agar bir tomon argues, ikkinchisi faqat claims qilsa, siz allaqachon g‘olibni tanlagansiz. Supporters argue, while critics contend: mana muvozanat.

scenes.title: Yashirin hukm
board: ✗ The regime finally admitted its brutal crackdown.
✓ The government acknowledged that security forces had used force.
✗ Everyone knows the election was rigged.
✓ Observers reported irregularities; the authorities deny this.
scenes.say_native: Bir gapda nechta yashirin hukm borligini ko‘ring: “regime” noqonuniylik, “finally admitted” ayb, “brutal crackdown” baho. Bularning hammasi xabarchining fikri. Xolis variantda faqat tasdiqlangan fakt va manba qoladi. Ikkinchi misolda “everyone knows” isbotsiz umumlashtirish. To‘g‘risi: kuzatuvchilar nima xabar qilgani va rasmiylar nima deganini yonma-yon berish.
scenes.say: Count the hidden verdicts in the regime finally admitted its brutal crackdown: regime, finally, admitted and brutal. A neutral version keeps only verified facts and attributes every claim to a source.
scenes.say_uz: The regime finally admitted its brutal crackdown gapidagi yashirin hukmlarni sanang: regime, finally, admitted va brutal. Xolis variant faqat tasdiqlangan faktlarni qoldiradi va har bir da’voni manbaga bog‘laydi.

scenes.title: Betaraf qiling
board: 1 The dictator's regime claimed victory.
2 Rebels committed atrocities, the army says. (keep attribution, remove the verdict from your own voice)
3 The minister admitted the plan would cost more.
4 Corrupt officials pocketed the funds. (unproven)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni xolis qiling. Bo‘yoqdor so‘zlarni toping, ularni betaraf so‘z bilan almashtiring yoki manbaga bog‘lang, kerak bo‘lsa “allegedly” yoki majhul keltirish tuzilmasini ishlating. Faktni yo‘qotmang, faqat hukmni olib tashlang. Pauza. Javobni yozib qo‘ying, keyin solishtiramiz.
scenes.say: Neutralise these. One: The dictator's regime claimed victory. Two: Rebels committed atrocities, the army says. Three: The minister admitted the plan would cost more. Four: Corrupt officials pocketed the funds.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni xolis qiling. Bir: Diktator rejimi g‘alaba da’vo qildi. Ikki: Isyonchilar vahshiylik qildi, deydi armiya. Uch: Vazir reja qimmatroq tushishini tan oldi. To‘rt: Poraxo‘r amaldorlar mablag‘ni o‘zlashtirdi.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1 The government declared victory.
2 The army accused rebel forces of atrocities.
3 The minister said the plan would cost more.
4 Officials allegedly misappropriated the funds.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: “The government declared victory”, “dictator” va “regime” baho, “claimed” esa shubha. Ikkinchi: “The army accused rebel forces of atrocities”, ayblov aniq manbaga bog‘langan. Uchinchi: “said”, chunki ortiq xarajat ayb emas. To‘rtinchi: “allegedly misappropriated”, sud qarori bo‘lmaguncha.
scenes.say: The government declared victory. The army accused rebel forces of atrocities. The minister said the plan would cost more. Officials allegedly misappropriated the funds.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat g‘alaba e’lon qildi. Armiya isyonchi kuchlarni vahshiylikda aybladi. Vazir reja qimmatroq tushishini aytdi. Amaldorlar mablag‘ni o‘zlashtirgani da’vo qilinmoqda.

scenes.title: Yangilik tahlili tuzilmasi
board: 1 What happened (verified facts)
2 Background and context
3 Stakeholders and their interests
4 Implications · 5 What remains uncertain
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: yangilikni tahlil qilish. Qisqa bayon va tahlil farqli. Tahlil besh qismdan iborat: nima bo‘ldi, ya’ni tasdiqlangan faktlar; fon, ya’ni voqea nimadan kelib chiqdi; manfaatdor tomonlar va ularning maqsadlari; oqibatlari; va hali noaniq nimalar qolgani. Oxirgi qism ko‘pincha unutiladi, lekin u xolislikning eng muhim belgisi.
scenes.say: A news analysis goes beyond the facts. It sets out the background, identifies the stakeholders and their interests, weighs the likely implications and states honestly what remains uncertain.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilik tahlili faktlardan nariga o‘tadi. U fonni bayon qiladi, manfaatdor tomonlar va ularning manfaatlarini aniqlaydi, ehtimoliy oqibatlarni baholaydi va nima noaniq qolganini halol aytadi.

scenes.title: Tahlil iboralari
board: The move is widely seen as... · signals...
could pave the way for... · raises questions about...
It remains to be seen whether...
is likely to · may well · cannot be ruled out

examples.t: It remains to be seen whether the ceasefire will hold.
examples.uz: O‘t ochishni to‘xtatish saqlanib qoladimi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Tahlil iboralari. “The move is widely seen as a signal of…” keng tarqalgan talqinni beradi, lekin sizning shaxsiy fikringiz emas. “Could pave the way for” biror narsaga yo‘l ochishi mumkin. “Raises questions about” savol tug‘diradi. “It remains to be seen whether” buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi. Ehtimol darajalari: “is likely to”, “may well”, “cannot be ruled out”.
scenes.say: Analytical language distinguishes interpretation from fact. The move is widely seen as, could pave the way for, raises questions about and it remains to be seen whether all signal careful, calibrated judgement.
scenes.say_uz: Tahlil tili talqinni faktdan ajratadi. The move is widely seen as, could pave the way for, raises questions about va it remains to be seen whether ehtiyotkor, o‘lchangan hukmni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy xabar
board: Arnoria and Veloria: a water-sharing agreement
Listen for: facts · background · stakeholders · implications · uncertainty
scenes.say_native: Endi namunaviy tahliliy xabarni tinglang. Davlatlar o‘ylab topilgan, shuning uchun hech bir haqiqiy tomonni olmaymiz. Besh qismni toping: fakt, fon, manfaatdor tomonlar, oqibat va noaniqlik. Fe’llar va ehtimol iboralariga ham e’tibor bering. Bu sizning uy vazifangiz uchun ham namuna.
scenes.say: Arnoria and Veloria signed a water-sharing agreement on Tuesday, ending a decade-long dispute over the Selan River. The deal follows a drought that reportedly cut harvests by a third. Arnorian officials hailed it as historic, while Velorian farmers' groups said it did not go far enough. The agreement could pave the way for wider trade talks, although it remains to be seen whether it will survive next year's elections.
scenes.say_uz: Arnoriya va Veloriya seshanba kuni suvdan birgalikda foydalanish to‘g‘risidagi kelishuvni imzoladi va Selan daryosi bo‘yicha o‘n yillik nizoga chek qo‘ydi. Kelishuv xabarlarga ko‘ra hosilni uchdan birga kamaytirgan qurg‘oqchilikdan keyin tuzildi. Arnoriya rasmiylari uni tarixiy deb olqishladi, Veloriya fermerlar guruhlari esa u yetarli emasligini aytdi. Kelishuv kengroq savdo muzokaralariga yo‘l ochishi mumkin, ammo u kelasi yilgi saylovlardan keyin ham saqlanib qoladimi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Xabar tahlili
board: Fact: signed on Tuesday, ending a dispute
Background: drought, reportedly
Stakeholders: officials (hailed) vs farmers (said)
Implication: could pave the way · Uncertainty: remains to be seen
scenes.say_native: Tahlil. Fakt: shartnoma seshanba kuni imzolandi. Fon: qurg‘oqchilik, “reportedly” bilan, chunki raqam tasdiqlanmagan. Tomonlar: rasmiylar va fermerlar, ikkalasi ham manbaga bog‘langan. “Hailed” bu rasmiylarning o‘z bahosi, xabarchiniki emas. Oqibat: “could pave the way”. Noaniqlik: “it remains to be seen”. Bitta ham baho sifati xabarchining o‘zidan emas.
scenes.say: Every evaluative word belongs to a source. Historic is the officials' word, not the reporter's. The figure is flagged with reportedly, and the analysis ends by naming what is still uncertain.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir baholovchi so‘z manbaga tegishli. Historic rasmiylarning so‘zi, xabarchiniki emas. Raqam reportedly bilan belgilangan, tahlil esa hali nima noaniqligini aytib tugaydi.

scenes.title: Fikrni tahlil deb berish
board: ✗ Clearly, the government is lying to its people.
✓ The government's figures differ from those of independent monitors.
✗ This deal will definitely bring peace.
✓ The deal may well reduce tensions, though much depends on...
scenes.say_native: Keng tarqalgan xato: shaxsiy fikrni tahlil sifatida berish. “Clearly, the government is lying” isbot emas, hukm. Xolis tahlil faktlarni yonma-yon qo‘yadi: hukumat raqamlari mustaqil kuzatuvchilarnikidan farq qiladi, xulosani o‘quvchi chiqaradi. Ikkinchi xato: kelajak haqida qat’iy bashorat. “Will definitely bring peace” o‘rniga “may well reduce tensions” deng.
scenes.say: Analysis is not opinion with confidence added. Instead of saying the government is lying, set the competing figures side by side. And replace certain predictions with calibrated ones: may well, is likely to.
scenes.say_uz: Tahlil ishonch qo‘shilgan fikr emas. Hukumat yolg‘on gapiryapti deyish o‘rniga qarama-qarshi raqamlarni yonma-yon qo‘ying. Qat’iy bashoratlarni o‘lchanganlari bilan almashtiring: may well, is likely to.

scenes.title: Tahlil gapini tuzing
board: Rewrite as calibrated analysis:
1 The sanctions will destroy their economy.
2 This visit shows the two countries are now friends.
3 Nobody knows if the treaty will be ratified.
scenes.say_native: Uchta qat’iy yoki noaniq gapni ehtiyotkor tahliliy gapga aylantiring. Bugungi iboralarni ishlating: “is likely to”, “is widely seen as”, “it remains to be seen whether”. Pauza oling va javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting yoki yozib qo‘ying. Kamida bittasini yozing.
scenes.say: Rewrite as calibrated analysis. One: The sanctions will destroy their economy. Two: This visit shows the two countries are now friends. Three: Nobody knows if the treaty will be ratified.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyotkor tahlilga aylantiring. Bir: Sanksiyalar ularning iqtisodiyotini yo‘q qiladi. Ikki: Bu tashrif ikki davlat endi do‘st ekanini ko‘rsatadi. Uch: Shartnoma ratifikatsiya qilinadimi, hech kim bilmaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1 The sanctions are likely to weaken the economy significantly.
2 The visit is widely seen as a sign of warming relations.
3 It remains to be seen whether the treaty will be ratified.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: “The sanctions are likely to weaken the economy significantly”, “destroy” mubolag‘a, “will” esa haddan qat’iy. Ikkinchi: “The visit is widely seen as a sign of warming relations”, “friends” diplomatik tilda juda sodda, “warming relations” esa standart ibora. Uchinchi: “It remains to be seen whether the treaty will be ratified.”
scenes.say: The sanctions are likely to weaken the economy significantly. The visit is widely seen as a sign of warming relations. It remains to be seen whether the treaty will be ratified.
scenes.say_uz: Sanksiyalar iqtisodiyotni sezilarli zaiflashtirishi ehtimoli bor. Tashrif munosabatlar iliqlashuvining belgisi sifatida keng qabul qilinmoqda. Shartnoma ratifikatsiya qilinadimi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Dialog: matbuot brifingi
board: Spokesperson · Journalist
A foreign ministry press briefing
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog: tashqi ishlar vazirligidagi matbuot brifingi. Jurnalist aniq savol beradi, vazirlik vakili esa diplomatik til bilan javob beradi. Quloq soling: vakil uchrashuvni qanday ta’riflaydi, elchi haqida nima deydi va qaysi savolga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob bermaydi.
scenes.say: Journalist: Can you confirm that the ambassador has been summoned? Spokesperson: I can confirm that we held a frank and candid meeting with the ambassador this morning. Journalist: Will sanctions follow? Spokesperson: We do not rule anything out at this stage. We remain committed to dialogue. Journalist: Is that a yes? Spokesperson: I've nothing further to add.
scenes.say_uz: Jurnalist: Elchi chaqirilganini tasdiqlay olasizmi? Vakil: Bugun ertalab elchi bilan ochiq va samimiy uchrashuv o‘tkazganimizni tasdiqlay olaman. Jurnalist: Sanksiyalar bo‘ladimi? Vakil: Hozircha hech narsani istisno qilmaymiz. Biz muloqotga sodiqmiz. Jurnalist: Bu “ha” deganimi? Vakil: Qo‘shimcha aytadigan gapim yo‘q.

scenes.title: Brifing bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 How does the spokesperson describe the meeting? What does it suggest?
2 Are sanctions confirmed or excluded?
3 Which question does the spokesperson avoid?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: vakil uchrashuvni qanday so‘zlar bilan ta’riflaydi va bu nimani anglatadi? Ikkinchi: sanksiyalar tasdiqlandimi yoki istisno qilindimi? Uchinchi: vakil qaysi savolga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob bermaydi? Diplomatik tilni “tarjima” qilishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One: How does the spokesperson describe the meeting, and what does it suggest? Two: Are sanctions confirmed or excluded? Three: Which question does the spokesperson avoid?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Vakil uchrashuvni qanday ta’riflaydi va bu nimani anglatadi? Ikki: Sanksiyalar tasdiqlandimi yoki istisno qilindimi? Uch: Vakil qaysi savoldan qochadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 'frank and candid' → serious disagreement
2 Neither: 'We do not rule anything out.'
3 'Is that a yes?' → 'I've nothing further to add.'
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “frank and candid meeting”, bu jiddiy kelishmovchilikni bildiradi, demak, elchi aslida norozilik uchun chaqirilgan. Ikkinchi: na tasdiqlandi, na istisno qilindi: “We do not rule anything out”. Bu ochiq qolgan bosim. Uchinchi: “Is that a yes?” savoliga vakil “I’ve nothing further to add” deb javobdan qochadi.
scenes.say: The meeting was frank and candid, implying serious disagreement. Sanctions are neither confirmed nor excluded. And when pressed, the spokesperson sidesteps the question with I've nothing further to add.
scenes.say_uz: Uchrashuv ochiq va samimiy bo‘lgan, bu jiddiy kelishmovchilikni anglatadi. Sanksiyalar na tasdiqlandi, na istisno qilindi. Bosim ostida esa vakil I’ve nothing further to add bilan savoldan chetlab o‘tadi.

scenes.title: Dialog: ikki tahlilchi
board: Presenter · Analyst A · Analyst B
The Arnoria–Veloria water agreement
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: radioda ikki tahlilchi Arnoriya va Veloriya kelishuvini muhokama qiladi. E’tibor bering: birinchi tahlilchi kelishuvni qanday baholaydi, ikkinchisi qanday xavfni ko‘radi va ular qaysi nuqtada kelishadi. Ehtiyotkor iboralarni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Presenter: Is this a breakthrough? Analyst A: It's widely seen as one, and it could pave the way for broader cooperation. Analyst B: I'd be more cautious. The deal depends on goodwill from a government that faces elections next year. Analyst A: That's fair. Much will depend on who wins. Analyst B: Exactly. It's a promising start, but it remains to be seen whether it will last.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Bu burilish nuqtasimi? A tahlilchi: Ko‘pchilik shunday deb hisoblaydi va u kengroq hamkorlikka yo‘l ochishi mumkin. B tahlilchi: Men ehtiyotkorroq bo‘lardim. Kelishuv kelasi yil saylovga kiradigan hukumatning xayrixohligiga bog‘liq. A tahlilchi: To‘g‘ri. Ko‘p narsa kim g‘olib bo‘lishiga bog‘liq. B tahlilchi: Aynan. Bu umidli boshlanish, ammo u uzoq davom etadimi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Tahlilchilar bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 How does Analyst A evaluate the deal?
2 What risk does Analyst B identify?
3 On what do they agree?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: A tahlilchi kelishuvni qanday baholaydi va qaysi ibora bilan? Ikkinchi: B tahlilchi qanday xavfni ko‘radi? Uchinchi: ular qaysi nuqtada kelishadi? Javobingizda dialogdagi ehtiyotkor iboralardan foydalaning. Javobni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: One: How does Analyst A evaluate the deal? Two: What risk does Analyst B identify? Three: On what do they agree?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: A tahlilchi kelishuvni qanday baholaydi? Ikki: B tahlilchi qanday xavfni ko‘radi? Uch: Ular nimada kelishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 widely seen as a breakthrough; could pave the way
2 It depends on a government facing elections.
3 Much depends on the election result.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: A kelishuvni ijobiy baholaydi, lekin o‘z nomidan emas: “widely seen as” va “could pave the way”. Ikkinchi: B xavfni ko‘radi: kelishuv kelasi yil saylovga kiradigan hukumatning xayrixohligiga bog‘liq. Uchinchi: ikkalasi ham ko‘p narsa saylov natijasiga bog‘liq degan fikrda kelishadi. E’tibor bering, B “I’d be more cautious” bilan muloyim e’tiroz bildiradi.
scenes.say: Analyst A is positive but attributes the view: widely seen as a breakthrough. Analyst B warns that the deal depends on a government facing elections. Both agree that much depends on the election result.
scenes.say_uz: A tahlilchi ijobiy, lekin fikrni boshqalarga bog‘laydi: widely seen as a breakthrough. B kelishuv saylovga kirayotgan hukumatga bog‘liqligidan ogohlantiradi. Ikkalasi ko‘p narsa saylov natijasiga bog‘liqligida kelishadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u ko‘chishi
board: POLitics → poLItical → poliTIcian
DIPlomat → diPLOmacy → diploMAtic
a CONflict (n) → to conFLICT (v)
a REcord (n) → to reCORD (v)
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Bu so‘z oilalarida urg‘u ko‘chadi: POLitics, poLItical, poliTIcian. DIPlomat, diPLOmacy, diploMAtic. O‘zbek o‘quvchilari ko‘pincha ruscha “диплОмат” ta’sirida urg‘uni noto‘g‘ri qo‘yadi. Ikki bo‘g‘inli ot va fe’l juftliklarida ot birinchi, fe’l ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda urg‘u oladi: a CONflict, lekin to conFLICT; a REcord, lekin to reCORD.
scenes.say: Listen: politics, political, politician. Diplomat, diplomacy, diplomatic. And for noun and verb pairs: a conflict, but the reports conflict; a record, but to record.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang: politics, political, politician. Diplomat, diplomacy, diplomatic. Ot va fe’l juftliklari: a conflict, lekin the reports conflict; a record, lekin to record.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: xolis xulosa
board: Summarise neutrally in 5 sentences:
Facts: Country X expelled two Country Y diplomats on Monday.
X says they were spying; Y denies it and calls the move 'baseless'.
Trade talks were due next month.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Faktlar ekranda. Besh gapli xolis xulosa va tahlil tuzing: nima bo‘ldi, ikkala tomon nima deydi, manbalarni aniq bog‘lang, bitta oqibatni ehtiyotkor ibora bilan ayting va nima noaniq qolganini aytib tugating. “Allegedly” yoki majhul keltirish tuzilmasini ishlating.
scenes.say: Final task. Summarise and analyse this story neutrally in five sentences. Country X expelled two diplomats from Country Y on Monday. X says they were spying; Y denies it. Trade talks were due next month.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Bu voqeani besh gapda xolis xulosa qiling va tahlil qiling. X davlati dushanba kuni Y davlatining ikki diplomatini chiqarib yubordi. X ularni josuslikda ayblaydi, Y buni rad etadi. Savdo muzokaralari kelasi oyga belgilangan edi.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: accused of · said · denied (balanced verbs)
is likely to complicate · remains to be seen
No adjectives of your own
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. Ayblov X ga, rad etish Y ga bog‘langan, “baseless” so‘zi Y ning o‘z bahosi sifatida iqtibosda berilgan. Oqibat “is likely to” bilan, noaniqlik esa “it remains to be seen” bilan. Xabarchining o‘zidan birorta ham baho sifati yo‘q. Shunday chiqqan bo‘lsa, siz xolis tahlil yozishni uddaladingiz.
scenes.say: On Monday, Country X expelled two diplomats from Country Y, accusing them of espionage. Y denied the allegation, describing the expulsions as baseless. The move comes weeks before planned trade talks between the two countries. It is likely to complicate those negotiations, and Y may respond in kind. It remains to be seen whether the talks will go ahead as scheduled.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba kuni X davlati Y davlatining ikki diplomatini josuslikda ayblab, chiqarib yubordi. Y ayblovni rad etib, chiqarib yuborishni asossiz deb atadi. Bu qadam ikki davlat o‘rtasidagi rejalashtirilgan savdo muzokaralaridan bir necha hafta oldin qo‘yildi. U muzokaralarni murakkablashtirishi ehtimoli bor va Y ham shunday javob qaytarishi mumkin. Muzokaralar rejadagidek o‘tadimi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: policy ≠ politics · economic ≠ economical
Decode diplomacy and headlines; don't copy headlinese
Neutral: said, according to, allegedly, balanced verbs
Analysis: context · stakeholders · implications · uncertainty
scenes.say_native: Jamlaymiz. Birinchi: siyosiy atamalarni aniq ishlating, policy va politics, economic va economical farqini unutmang. Ikkinchi: diplomatik iboralar va sarlavhalarni “tarjima” qila oling, lekin sarlavha so‘zlarini rasmiy matnga ko‘chirmang. Uchinchi: xolis bo‘ling, betaraf fe’llar, manbaga bog‘lash va muvozanat. To‘rtinchi: tahlilda fon, tomonlar, oqibat va noaniqlikni ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: To recap: use political terms precisely, decode diplomatic and headline language, report neutrally with balanced verbs and clear attribution, and build analysis around context, stakeholders, implications and uncertainty.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: siyosiy atamalarni aniq ishlating, diplomatik va sarlavha tilini oching, betaraf fe’llar va aniq manba bilan xolis xabar bering hamda tahlilni fon, tomonlar, oqibat va noaniqlik atrofida quring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: summarise and analyse an international news story
150–200 words · both sides · 3 neutral reporting verbs
1 hedged implication · end with what remains uncertain
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: yaqinda bo‘lgan bitta xalqaro yangilikni tanlang va uni inglizcha xolis xulosa qilib, tahlil qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bir yuz ellik–ikki yuz so‘z, ikkala tomonning pozitsiyasi, kamida uchta betaraf keltirish fe’li, xabarchining o‘z baho sifatlari yo‘q, bitta ehtiyotkor oqibat va noaniqlik bilan yakun. Keyingi darsda ilmiy maqola uslubida yozishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, summarise and analyse a recent international news story in about two hundred words, presenting both sides with neutral verbs and ending with what remains uncertain. Next time we turn to scientific writing.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: yaqindagi xalqaro yangilikni ikki yuz so‘z atrofida xulosa qilib, tahlil qiling, ikkala tomonni betaraf fe’llar bilan bering va nima noaniq qolgani bilan tugating. Keyingi safar ilmiy yozuvga o‘tamiz.

homework_uz: Yaqinda bo‘lgan bitta xalqaro yangilikni tanlab, uni inglizcha 150–200 so‘zda xolis xulosa qiling va tahlil qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ikkala tomonning pozitsiyasi, kamida uchta betaraf keltirish fe’li (said, stated, according to), xabarchining o‘z baho sifatlari yo‘q, bitta ehtiyotkor oqibat (is likely to, could) va “it remains to be seen” kabi noaniqlik bilan yakun.

quiz.why_uz: Aniq yo‘l yoki reja policy deyiladi; tashqi siyosat foreign policy.
Economic iqtisodiyotga oid, economical esa tejamkor.

quiz.q: In British English, to 'table a motion' means to...
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada table taklif kiritish, Amerikada esa chetga surish.
Diplomatik tilda bu ibora jiddiy kelishmovchilikni bildiradi.

quiz.q: The headline 'Minister to visit Tashkent' refers to...
Which reporting verb is the most neutral?
quiz.why_uz: Said betaraf; claimed shubha, admitted ayb, insisted qarshilik ma’nosini qo‘shadi.

options: The regime finally admitted the crackdown.
The government acknowledged that security forces had used force.
Everyone knows the government is guilty.
quiz.why_uz: Bo‘yoqdor so‘zlar olib tashlangan va fakt aniq berilgan.

quiz.q: A suspect has not yet been convicted. Which is appropriate?
Which phrase signals uncertainty about the future?
options: It remains to be seen whether
quiz.why_uz: It remains to be seen whether noaniqlikni xolis bildiradi.
Diplomat da urg‘u birinchi, diplomacy da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda.
